title: dembrane v3: AI
description: How the model calls behave: volume, latency, context size, errors, refusals and an estimated cost, per Amsterdam day and over time. Counts and sizes only, never text. The first row compares every environment; the rest follows the Environment choice.

panels.title: Every environment, over the selected time (this row does not follow the Environment choice)
Production
panels.description: Tokens of every model call production made in the selected time, from its own record of calls, and the estimate at the prices above. The record holds 7 days at this detail.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as "input tokens", coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as "output tokens", round(coalesce(sum(input_tokens * (case when model like '%pro%' then ${price_in_pro} else ${price_in_flash} end) + output_tokens * (case when model like '%pro%' then ${price_out_pro} else ${price_out_flash} end)), 0)::numeric / 1000000, 2) as "estimated cost" from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute)

panels.title: Staging
panels.description: Tokens of every model call staging made in the selected time, from its own record of calls, and the estimate at the prices above. The record holds 7 days at this detail.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as "input tokens", coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as "output tokens", round(coalesce(sum(input_tokens * (case when model like '%pro%' then ${price_in_pro} else ${price_in_flash} end) + output_tokens * (case when model like '%pro%' then ${price_out_pro} else ${price_out_flash} end)), 0)::numeric / 1000000, 2) as "estimated cost" from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute)

panels.title: Previews (Google's count)
panels.description: All pull request previews together. A preview's own record goes away with the preview, so this is Google's count of the tokens its project used. The estimate takes the flash prices for every model. Which preview used them: the staging and previews dashboard.

panels.title: sam (the team's agent)
panels.description: Selected time. Input total includes cached input. Thinking is part of output total, never an extra addend. Every model turn sends its context again; input is not unique text. Other environments do not yet store these breakdowns. Sam cost uses other prices on its own dashboard.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(input_tokens),0) as "input total", coalesce(sum(cached_tokens),0) as "cached input", coalesce(sum(input_tokens-coalesce(cached_tokens,0)),0) as "uncached input", coalesce(sum(output_tokens),0) as "output total", sum(thoughts_tokens) as "thinking (in output)" from obs.sam_model_calls where $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Tokens per hour, by environment
panels.description: Input plus output tokens per hour; an hour without calls has no point. The axis is logarithmic, so a small environment stays visible next to production. Previews are Google's count; the others are the environment's own record.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(minute, 1h, NULL), sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) as "production" from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute) group by 1 order by 1
select $__timeGroupAlias(minute, 1h, NULL), sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) as "staging" from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute) group by 1 order by 1
select $__timeGroupAlias(minute, 1h, NULL), sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) as "sam" from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: sam: cache and thinking, over the selected time
sam: cache, thinking coverage and record age
panels.description: Cache share is cached / total input. Thinking share uses only calls reporting thinking. Coverage names the share reporting it. Thinking tokens measure work used, not the configured LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH setting. The model record loads every ten minutes.

targets.rawSql: select 100.0*sum(cached_tokens)/nullif(sum(input_tokens),0) as "input from cache", 100.0*sum(thoughts_tokens)/nullif(sum(output_tokens) filter(where thoughts_tokens is not null),0) as "thinking share of output", 100.0*count(*) filter(where thoughts_tokens is not null)/nullif(count(*),0) as "calls reporting thinking", (select extract(epoch from now()-loaded_at) from obs.sam_loads where source='model_calls') as "age of model record" from obs.sam_model_calls where $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: sam input: cached and uncached
panels.description: Hourly totals. These two parts add to input total.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, 1h), sum(cached_tokens) as cached, sum(input_tokens-coalesce(cached_tokens,0)) as uncached from obs.sam_model_calls where $__timeFilter(started_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: sam output: thinking and other output
panels.description: Only calls reporting thinking. These parts add to output for those calls; coverage is shown above.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, 1h), sum(thoughts_tokens) as thinking, sum(output_tokens-thoughts_tokens) as "other output" from obs.sam_model_calls where $__timeFilter(started_at) and thoughts_tokens is not null group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Model calls
panels.description: Every attempt at a model deployment that day: generate, stream and embed.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(calls), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(sum(calls), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Prompt tokens sent that day, all calls. Audio counts as input tokens.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: Tokens the models produced that day, thinking included where the vendor counts it.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Average context per call (tokens)
panels.description: Input tokens divided by successful calls: how much context one request carries on average.

targets.rawSql: select round(sum(input_tokens)::numeric / greatest(sum(calls - errors), 1)) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select round(sum(input_tokens)::numeric / greatest(sum(calls - errors), 1)) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Largest request (tokens)
panels.description: The biggest prompt of the day, in input tokens.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(max(max_input_tokens), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(max(max_input_tokens), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: p95 latency (s)
panels.description: 95 % of successful model calls that day answered within this many seconds (a stream counts until its last token).

targets.rawSql: select round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by ms) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) as value from obs.model_calls where (started_at at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date and status = 'ok'

select round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by ms) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) as value from obs.model_calls where (started_at at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1) and status = 'ok'

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Attempts that failed that day (rate limit, server error, timeout, bad request).

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(errors), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(sum(errors), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Attempts after the first one on the same request that day.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(retries), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(sum(retries), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Fallbacks
panels.description: Calls answered by a later deployment in the group because the first ones failed.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(fallbacks), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(sum(fallbacks), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Refusals
panels.description: Answers the model refused: finish reason safety, recitation, blocklist or the like. Usually zero characters came back.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(refusals), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(sum(refusals), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Truncated
panels.description: Answers cut at the output token limit.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(truncated), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date
select coalesce(sum(truncated), 0) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Estimated cost (EUR)
panels.description: Estimate only: tokens times the prices in the dashboard variables (EUR per million tokens). The invoice is Vertex billing in the Google project; set the variables from it.

targets.rawSql: select round(sum(input_tokens * (case when model like '%pro%' then ${price_in_pro} else ${price_in_flash} end) + output_tokens * (case when model like '%pro%' then ${price_out_pro} else ${price_out_flash} end))::numeric / 1000000, 2) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date

select round(sum(input_tokens * (case when model like '%pro%' then ${price_in_pro} else ${price_in_flash} end) + output_tokens * (case when model like '%pro%' then ${price_out_pro} else ${price_out_flash} end))::numeric / 1000000, 2) as value from obs.day_model_calls where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1)

panels.title: Model calls by operation and model, today
panels.description: The operation is the job (conversations.chunk is transcription, conversations.summarize the summary, reports.generate the report) or the API route (chats, assistant) that made the call.

targets.rawSql: select operation, model_group as "group", model, sum(calls) as calls, sum(errors) as errors, sum(refusals) as refusals, sum(retries) as retries, sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens, round(sum(input_tokens)::numeric / greatest(sum(calls - errors), 1)) as avg_input, max(max_input_tokens) as max_input, max(p95_ms) as p95_ms from obs.day_model_calls where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date group by 1, 2, 3 order by calls desc

panels.title: Largest requests, today
panels.description: The twenty calls with the most input tokens today. No text, only sizes and times.

targets.rawSql: select started_at, operation, model, kind, input_tokens, output_tokens, ms, finish_reason, status from obs.model_calls where (started_at at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date order by input_tokens desc nulls last limit 20

panels.title: Model calls per 5 minutes, by operation
panels.description: Attempts per bucket, by the job or route that made them. Reads the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(minute, 5m), operation as metric, sum(calls) as value from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Errors per 5 minutes, by model
panels.description: Failed attempts per bucket, by deployment.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(minute, 5m), model as metric, sum(errors) as value from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Latency per 5 minutes (s): average and slowest, by group
panels.description: Average and slowest call per bucket for each model group.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(minute, 5m), model_group || ' avg' as metric, sum(avg_ms * calls)::double precision / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1000.0 as value from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute) group by 1, 2 union all select $__timeGroupAlias(minute, 5m), model_group || ' max' as metric, max(max_ms) / 1000.0 as value from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Tokens per 5 minutes
panels.description: Input and output tokens per bucket, all calls.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(minute, 5m), sum(input_tokens) as input, sum(output_tokens) as output from obs.minute_model_calls where $__timeFilter(minute) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Last 35 days, one bar per day (own window, whatever the range above)
Tokens per day by model, last 35 days
panels.description: Input plus output tokens, one bar per Amsterdam day, by deployment. This panel always shows the last 35 days.

targets.rawSql: select day as time, model as metric, sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) as value from obs.day_model_calls group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Calls, errors and refusals per day, last 35 days
panels.description: One bar per Amsterdam day, all operations. This panel always shows the last 35 days.

targets.rawSql: select day as time, sum(calls) as calls, sum(errors) as errors, sum(refusals) as refusals from obs.day_model_calls group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Transcription step (pipeline timing, includes download and save)
Transcriptions completed
panels.description: Chunk transcriptions that completed that day.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(n), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date and event = 'task_transcribe_chunk.completed'
select coalesce(sum(n), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1) and event = 'task_transcribe_chunk.completed'

panels.title: Transcription p50 (s)
panels.description: Median time of the transcription step that day.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(max(p50_ms / 1000.0), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date and event = 'task_transcribe_chunk.completed'
select coalesce(max(p50_ms / 1000.0), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1) and event = 'task_transcribe_chunk.completed'

panels.title: Transcription p95 (s)
panels.description: 95 % of transcription steps finished within this time that day.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(max(p95_ms / 1000.0), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date and event = 'task_transcribe_chunk.completed'
select coalesce(max(p95_ms / 1000.0), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1) and event = 'task_transcribe_chunk.completed'

panels.title: Transcriptions failed
panels.description: Transcription steps that failed that day; the chunk is retried.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(n), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date and event = 'task_transcribe_chunk.failed'
select coalesce(sum(n), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1) and event = 'task_transcribe_chunk.failed'

panels.title: Summaries p95 (s)
panels.description: 95 % of conversation summaries finished within this time that day.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(max(p95_ms / 1000.0), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date and event = 'task_summarize_conversation.completed'
select coalesce(max(p95_ms / 1000.0), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1) and event = 'task_summarize_conversation.completed'

panels.title: Summaries failed
panels.description: Summary steps that failed that day.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(n), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = (now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date and event = 'task_summarize_conversation.failed'
select coalesce(sum(n), 0) as value from obs.day_pipeline where day = ((now() at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date - 1) and event = 'task_summarize_conversation.failed'
